title: NIST WebBook: Hydrogen chloride gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 2 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Hydrogen chloride. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Hydrogen chloride (CAS 7647-01-0) print: -92.31 ± 0.10 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Cox, Wagman, et al., 1984, comment: CODATA Review value (experimental or compiled row) | -92.31 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Chase, 1998, comment: Data last reviewed in September, 1964 (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
